SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member=m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event)>7

WITH f AS (SELECT e.event_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a WHERE a.link_to_event=e.event_id) c FROM event e WHERE date(e.event_date) BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'),
w AS (SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id=a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name='Women''s Soccer'),
v AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(c),1) avg FROM f)
SELECT w.c AS womens_soccer_attendees, v.avg AS avg_fall_2019_attendees, CASE WHEN w.c>v.avg THEN 'more' WHEN w.c<v.avg THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS verdict FROM w, v

WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM major WHERE college='College of Humanities and Social Sciences')
SELECT d.department, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mj.major_name) AS majors_offered,
 (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mj2.major_name) FROM major mj2 WHERE mj2.department=d.department AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.link_to_major=mj2.major_id)) AS majors_held,
 ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN major mj3 ON mj3.major_id=m.link_to_major WHERE mj3.department=d.department)/COUNT(DISTINCT mj.major_id),2) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM d JOIN major mj ON mj.department=d.department GROUP BY d.department

SELECT mj.department, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount),0) AS total_dues FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM major WHERE college=(SELECT college FROM major WHERE department='Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')) d
JOIN major mj ON mj.department=d.department
LEFT JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major=mj.major_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance a WHERE a.link_to_member=m.member_id)
LEFT JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member=m.member_id AND i.source='Dues'
GROUP BY mj.department

SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM income i WHERE i.source='Dues' AND i.link_to_member IN (SELECT a.link_to_member FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id=a.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name='Football game')
SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendees FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event=e.event_id WHERE e.type='Budget' GROUP BY e.event_id
